scope: Checked repository facts only; no reconstructed candidate execution or production qualification was performed.

requiredCategories.boundary: The recorded unsupported option is the only checked option-validation reference; no separate option matrix is inferred.
The checked corpus has no distinct malformed-input case; invalid-input coverage is not promoted to this category.
The exact argument and stderr bytes remain those of the checked case; no alternate identity or output is substituted.

identitySubstitutionPolicy.rule: Required candidate comparisons must retain exact exit code and normalized stdout/stderr bytes from the versioned reference case. The corpus declares zero normalizations; no version, target, path, diagnostic, or artifact identity substitution is permitted by this record.

unavailableGates: Authenticated reconstructed-driver replay for every inventory case, including candidate executable, source/build revision, and run receipt.
Independent candidate comparison of exit code and normalized stdout/stderr, with every mismatch retained as release-blocking evidence.
Malformed-input reference capture required to close the inventory category marked unavailable.
Downstream qualification and release-gate consumers (#707, #708, #717, #718, and #719) remain open.
productionGap.ghidraIsolation: Any production analysis must use the application-bundled Ghidra Java APIs in an isolated worker; GHIDRA_HOME and external analyzeHeadless installations are not production prerequisites.
productionGap.oracleBoundary: The authenticated source lock, oracle manifest, build record, and reference corpus are read-only oracle inputs. They do not establish reconstructed source, candidate receipts, candidate fidelity, or release eligibility.
productionGap.unresolvedHandling: Unavailable cases and production artifacts remain explicitly unresolved and are not counted as accepted candidate behavior.
